security_privacy_cost_impact: Tenant isolation logic (no I/O yet): the resolver treats the client's scope selection as untrusted and reads only its own keys, refuses client-supplied actor, locale, timezone and ids, answers every unadmitted scope with one error so existence is not revealed, and keeps nothing from a failing or throwing dependency; the envelope builders accept only resolver-minted contexts. Synthetic ids only; no provider, credential, network, clock or randomness; no cost.

known_limitations: No runner yet turns a thrown value into an internal-error envelope. The resolver maps its ports' failures itself and keeps none of their thrown values; platform-kernel's own throws are constant-message errors (UntrustedTenantContextError, InvalidEnvelopeError, TypeError) on a programming fault; an in-process argument whose getter throws propagates that throw from the checkers, the builders and idempotencyOutcome unchanged (R0-261-3). Nothing catches these until the deferred runner lands.
